verdict.rationale: Pika publishes its own API: a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec at api.dev.pika.art, keyed calls and machine-readable per-operation pages. That lets automation generate media programmatically without the web UI, but nothing documents a CLI, CI integration or headless workflow guidance. The vendor also states there is no separate test environment, so every automated run is billed against production. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs, non-production sandbox for CI runs, hands-on or independent corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Generate video, image, and audio with hosted models.
